Resolves #3335

Batches `Neo.form.field.Text#updateError(value, silent)` under `silentVdomUpdate` so `me.cls = cls` no longer triggers a premature `afterSetCls()` render before `.neo-textfield-error-wrapper` is updated, and updates `Neo.form.field.Text#reset(value)` to restore `clean` to its initial config, clear any active/external error silently before `super.reset(value)`, and emit at most one `update()` with the `change` event firing last.

Evidence: L1 (Playwright unit suite `test/playwright/unit/form/field/TextReset.spec.mjs` + full 124-test `test/playwright/unit/form/` run) → L1 required (all acceptance criteria covered by unit tests).

## AC Evidence
| AC-1 | `test/playwright/unit/form/field/TextReset.spec.mjs` (`reset() triggers only one VDOM update, clears error state before firing change, and fires change at the end`, `updateError(value, false) triggers exactly one VDOM update and updateError(value, true) is completely silent`, `reset() clears error in a single VDOM update even when value was already null`) |

## Deltas from ticket
- Instead of extracting a duplicate helper out of `afterSetValue()`, leverages the reference-counted `Component#silentVdomUpdate_` (`#4305`) inside `updateError()` and clears error state silently before `super.reset(value)` so `Field#afterSetValue`'s `createSequence` fires `change` at the very end after the single `update()` call. Also restores `me.clean = me.originalConfig.clean ?? true` and flushes a single `update()` when `me.value === oldValue` (e.g. resetting an already-`null` field after `validate(false)` or `setErrors()`).

## Test Evidence
All coverage runs in CI.

### 🧭 Patch-Blind Premise Snapshot

*   **Inputs Read Before Patch:**
    - #3335 and Maryam's intake comment, which carries the Contract Ledger.
    - `src/form/field/Text.mjs` at `dev`:
      - `afterSetValue` (l.942) already batches under `silentVdomUpdate`, then makes one `update()` and fires `change`.
      - `reset` (l.1604) runs `super.reset`, then an extra `updateError(null)`, which is a second update.
      - In `updateError` (l.1646), `me.cls = cls` renders on its own, even with `silent = true`.
      - `clean` is a plain class field (l.313).
    - `VdomLifecycle`: no `afterSetSilentVdomUpdate`, so releasing the counter never flushes. `update()` defers while silent and sets `needsVdomUpdate`.
*   **Expected Solution Shape:**
    - Batch `updateError`'s `cls` and error-node mutations under `silentVdomUpdate`, so `silent` is honored.
    - `reset()` makes at most one update and fires `change` after the state settles.
    - **Boundary not to hardcode:** a second value path beside `afterSetValue`.
    - **Test isolation:** count active `update()` calls on a unit field, and record the event order.
*   **Patch Verdict:** It improves on the expected shape.
    - The batching rides the existing counter.
    - `reset()` clears the error silently before `super.reset`, so `afterSetValue` makes the one render and `change` follows it.
    - The new same-value branch, `me.value === oldValue`, flushes that cleared state with one update and correctly fires no `change`.
*   **Premise Coherence:** Coheres with verify-before-assert. The spec asserts update counts and event order, not "looks right".

**Challenge OR documented search (per guide §7.1):**

- **Challenge (non-blocking):** `reset()` restores `clean` from `originalConfig.clean ?? true`, which covers the documented default and an instance config. A subclass that declares the class field as `clean = false` would be reset to `true`. No class in `src`, `apps` or `examples` does that today (grep: none), so this is latent. If one appears, capture the constructed value instead of defaulting.

  Also worth knowing as a user-visible effect: after `reset()`, a field that had shown errors hides them again until the next `validate(false)`. That matches `clean`'s JSDoc ("errors will stay hidden … unless you trigger validate(false)"), and the Deltas name the restore.
